en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of an Eastern Orthodox church. The view looks toward a large, multi‑tiered iconostasis covered with icons of saints and biblical scenes, surmounted by ornate arches filled with frescoes. A massive multi‑branch chandelier hangs in the center. The columns and vaults are densely painted with iconographic images and ornamental patterns. The framing and sepia tone suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
